text_block_list.text:
With her long-awaited race debut just
around the
corner, Кинг Хало declares
with a powerful and
confident laugh that
she'll be the first to debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Amid this, we catch Грасс Вандер's
recent debut
being praised on a TV
program playing in the
waiting room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As it turns out, Кинг Хало wasn't the first
to debut
after all. But it doesn't matter,
because our goal
is to claim first place.
It's time to get out there
and win!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
